setup.notAPayload: this file does not contain KyberNow Station. Download the full installer again.
setup.webview2Missing:
To display its window, setup needs Microsoft Edge WebView2, a Microsoft component. It comes with Windows 11 and most Windows 10 installations, but it is missing on this computer.

Microsoft's download page will open: install it, then run KyberNow-Station-Setup again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall KyberNow Station
uninstall.confirm:
KyberNow Station will be removed from this computer, along with the Kyber engine, KyberNow Admin, the tray icon and the virtual display. The power mode and the network type (“Public” or “Private”) go back to what they were before the installation.

The controller driver (ViGEmBus) stays installed, as other software may use it.

Continue?
uninstall.keepData:
Keep KyberNow Station's settings on this computer?

Yes: the C:\ProgramData\KyberNow folder stays, readable by administrators only. It holds Admin's settings and certificate, known devices, logs and a copy of Kyber's settings.
No: everything is deleted.
uninstall.doneKept: KyberNow Station has been uninstalled. Its settings remain in C:\ProgramData\KyberNow.

ui.rebootReason: Restarting to finish installing KyberNow Station

gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.noneDetail: The processor will compress the picture itself (x264). This is slower and keeps it busier.

driver.title: Graphics driver
driver.unknown: Unknown version: consider updating the graphics card driver.
driver.none: No graphics card driver. Install the one from the manufacturer (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel) so the card can compress the picture.

network.title: Local network
network.wifi: Wi-Fi · {ip} · an Ethernet cable avoids short dropouts
network.public: · network set to “Public”: setup will switch it to “Private” so your devices can connect

ports.title: Network ports
ports.defaultBusy: The usual port 8080 is already in use{by}.
ports.picked: {reason}Free ports, picked at random: stream {stream} · Admin {console}

display.title: Main display
display.none: No display detected: plug in a display or turn on the virtual display.

power.title: Power mode
power.tuned: The graphics card keeps its full power during sessions.
power.notTuned: The graphics card slows down to save energy, and compressing each picture can take up to three times longer. The Options step offers to change this mode.

audio.title: Sound on your devices
audio.ok: Steam's virtual speakers found: during a session, sound plays on your device (stereo, 5.1 or 7.1) and the computer stays quiet.
audio.missing: Steam is not installed: sound will also play on the computer, in the format set in Windows. To send it to your device only, install Steam, then run setup again.

existing.title: Existing installation
existing.keepChoice: At the next step, you will choose to keep your settings and devices, or to start from scratch.
existing.noSettings: Its settings cannot be found: the installation will start from scratch.
existing.kyberDetail: It will be removed and replaced by KyberNow Station, which includes the same engine, set up for you.

ports.samePort: The stream and Admin need two different ports.
ports.reservedBy: Port {port} is in the range {owner} often uses ({first}–{last}): choose another one.

install.settingsMissing: settings not found ({path}): choose “Start from scratch”

install.trayShortcut: KyberNow Station in the notification area
